populationBaseNote: Population base is Census 2011 (lakhs); NCRB rates use this base.
source: NCRB Crime in India (2022-2024), via OpenCity (data.opencity.in)
headBreakdownNote: NCRB does not publish a per-offence breakdown at city level for this city in the sourced tables; the city total and its multi-year trend are shown. Per-head data will be added when parsed from NCRB head-wise tables.
